messages:
Ava (CS): Heads-up — evening hands-on for the Zephyr trial cohort tomorrow at 7:00pm PT. I was slated to run it but a calendar conflict came up. Can someone swap or cover? Prework: https://rwd.co/zephyr-prework :spiral_calendar:

Ravi - Enablement: I can cover if someone drops facilitator notes + VM link in the doc. How many attendees?

Ava (CS): 18 signed up (mostly engineers + 2 execs). Agenda is intro + 30m lab + 15m Q&A. Notes: https://rwd.co/zephyr-notes

Elise (Ops): I can join and run the first 40m (intros + get folks into the lab) but need the VM URL + quick runbook and the deck. Can someone paste them here by EOD?

Miguel (AM): FYI two execs are flagged as renewal-risk (low usage). If we can shift a few minutes to discuss production rollout & entitlements, that might improve signal. Can we add a 5-min "entitlements & next steps" segment?

Samira (CSM): Quick reaction poll: :lab_coat: = keep lab-heavy, :chart_with_upwards_trend: = pivot to rollout-focused. React or reply with your pick.

Ava (CS): Good call. I'll add a 5-min entitlements slide. @Ravi if you take the session, please emphasize infra/perf and next-step asks for the execs.

Ravi - Enablement: I'll take it. Please drop the VM link + minimal facilitator runbook (snippets are fine). Also is there a quick checklist for post-session follow-up for renewal accounts?

Elise (Ops): VM: https://rwd.co/zephyr-vm. Runbook (short):
```
1) Share VM link in chat and confirm 1-2 folks can SSH in
2) Provide starter notebook: /workshops/zephyr/starter.ipynb
3) If KV cache issues occur, restart container with `docker restart zephyr-lab`
4) For perf tuning demo: set batch_size=8, use quantized model variant
```
Deck: added slide "Entitlements & Next Steps" to the shared doc.

calendar-bot: Event updated — "Zephyr: Evening hands-on (Facilitator: Ravi)" tomorrow 7:00pm PT — guests: 18 — conference: Zoom.

Ava (CS): Final short agenda:
- 0–10m: Intros & goals (Elise)
- 10–40m: Guided lab (Ravi)
- 40–45m: Entitlements & next steps (Ava)
- 45–60m: Targeted Q&A — focus on prod rollout blockers (team)

Miguel (AM): I'll reach out to the two execs before the session to surface concrete rollout questions.

Samira (CSM): Post-session plan: I'll send the feedback form and tag renewal-risk accounts for prioritized follow-up. Will also add recommended playbook steps into the ticket.

Ravi - Enablement: Sounds good. I'll rehearse 15m before — ping if you want to join.

Ava (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll send a 2h reminder to attendees and update CS notes with the swap. :thumbsup:
